items.source: Can be injected into application code and used to define a custom ConcurrentKafkaListenerContainerFactory whose configuration is based upon that produced by auto-configuration.
items.translation: 可注入到应用程序代码中，用于定义一个自定义的 ConcurrentKafkaListenerContainerFactory，其配置基于自动配置所产生的配置。

items.source:
Configure the specified Kafka listener container factory. The factory can be
further tuned and default settings can be overridden.
items.translation: 配置指定的 Kafka 监听器容器工厂。该工厂可进一步调整，并可覆盖默认设置。

items.source: Gary Russell, Eddú Meléndez, Thomas Kåsene, Moritz Halbritter
Configure the specified Kafka listener container factory.
items.translation: 配置指定的 Kafka 监听器容器工厂。
